tgt_text: Ogochancha etugo ase chingaki chionsi nigo egotanga amarwaire yetugo korwa amanene. Abanyagitari betugo nkoba bare negeseto chingaki endwari yetugo egwateks na mbuya abaremi koba nomobaro bwetugo yabo.

src_text: Large gatherings increase theft risks. Supervise herds and coordinate with security agencies.
tgt_text: Omoganda omonenenbwabanto nigo okongusa abaibi. Renda etugo yao buya na bwaterana nabarendi boborendi.

src_text: Multiple identification methods enhance security. Brands, tags, and microchips support recovery.
tgt_text: Beka etugo yao ebimanyererio ao ao gokonya kobirenda korwa oboibi. Chisambererie ekemanyererio, beka chipachi amato, and Kobekera chiombe ekagento gete ime yerisankwa riabo nechera eyemo yogotanga oboibi bwetugo ekiagera ekero yaibirwe egento keria kebisire ime yerisankwa nabo gekoorokia goetera eintaneti ase etugo eyio ere nakoyebwatia bwango.

src_text: The Ministry of Public Service reminds job seekers that all internship postings are free to apply for. Avoid anyone asking for bribes or airtime in return
tgt_text: Eminisitiri yobokoreri bwabanto nkoinyoria are abakorogia egasi nga baria bakorigia gosoa ase okwegera mono igoro yamosomo abo nigo agwancherwa na gosoa bosa. Kana monto onde bwensi oragosabe riaki.

src_text: The Judiciary warns of false bail refund letters sent to unsuspecting litigants. Refunds are processed only through court registries
tgt_text: Ekoti yaonyire abanto igoro yamarube oborimo ogotomwa gochia ekoti korigia koiranerigwa chibesa babegete ebondi false bail refund letters sent to unsuspecting litigants. Okoiranerigwa chibesa chiepondi nkotini kogokorerwa na tari ande onsi.

src_text: "CBK reminds Kenyans that any investment requiring you to recruit others to earn returns is likely a pyramid scheme. Report such activities immediately."
tgt_text: "Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) nkoinyoria ere aba'Kenyan ng'a moroberio bwokobeka chibesa ande yonsi eganetie orike abanto gosoa aroro erio konyora eng'eria rnigo enga buna emeroberio yoboibi buna eria ya pyramid scheme. Karwe eripoti ya yobokenga ebwo kegima kwayarora."

src_text: "Fraudsters posing as election observers have been soliciting money from aspirants for fake clearance. IEBC does not charge for clearance forms."
tgt_text: "Abangainereria bagwekora buna abarigereria buna chikura chigoakwa babeire bagosangereria chibesa korwa ase baria bakorigia chikura kobarusia korwa erkodi yogokora bobe. Ekeombe keria gietenenerete buna chikura chiogoakwa (IEBC) nkeri gosaba chibesa erio korigereria gose nore namamocho aragotange toboria goakerwa chikura."

src_text: Those job ads for 'NGO agents hiring enumerators' without an interview are a scam. Verify with the actual NGO before sending money."
tgt_text: Amangana ogosegeta korwa abaagenti ba'NGO ng'a nkorika bare abanto bakorika amang'ana gotakorigwa ogotemwa kwemeremo namangana oborimo. Manya boronge ng'a NGO ki yatomete amang'ana ayio."

src_text: "The Ministry of Agriculture has disowned individuals collecting registration fees for 'subsidized fertilisers. All legitimate lists are displayed at ward offices."
tgt_text: "Eminisitiri yoboremi yangire abanto abanto bagosangereria chibesa chiokwerika ase okonyora obwoyo bweserikari. Amariko akworokia emeroberio eyio nkonantigwa are ase kera Ewodi Yomokansera oino."

src_text: If you are using a cyber computer, log out after using your Gmail!
tgt_text: Onye kogotumia ekombiuta yesaiba, rimia Gmail akaonti yao ekero gwakorire korora ebinto gwatagete!

src_text: If someone says 'I'm with DCI, help me fix your computer', hang up! It's a scam.
tgt_text: Omonto aise kogotebi 'nao inde nomotuku omonene, nkonye nkoroserie enkombiuta yao, rimia omonto oyio korwa enkwara nere! Oyo nkogokona are akoibere anamangana ao korwa ekombiuta.

src_text: Back up important data to an external drive to avoid ransomware attacks.
tgt_text: Rosia ekopi yamangana ao yengencho ase esimi goe ekombiuta gochia ekegachi kende terio gwekonya korwa ogosarigwa nebinyinyi

src_text: Enable 'Find My Device' on phones to track them if lost or stolen.
tgt_text: Ase chisimi bata Enable' Rigia Esimi Yane' ase chisimi erio koyebwatia ekero yasirire gose koibwa.

src_text: Avoid public USB charging stations They can steal your data.
tgt_text: Erende korwa nogochacherigwa esimi yao nomorande o USB. Ebi nabo biraibe amang'ana ao.

src_text: "If you receive an email asking you to verify your bank account, dont click it's phishing. Report to the DCI Cybercrime Unit."
tgt_text: "If you receive an email asking you to verify your bank account, dont click it's phishing. Report to the DCI Cybercrime Unit."

src_text: Put emergency contacts in your phone: Police (999), Ambulance (911), Fire (990).
tgt_text: Bechaka chinamba chiemebasekano ime ase esimi yao: Porisi (999), Egari yemebasekano (911), Omorero bwatekire (990).

src_text: If you see water on the road, do not try to cross it - It may be deep.
tgt_text: Korarore amache ase epara, tobaisa gotamboka- nabo oranyore amache ayio namange orimere.

src_text: Always supervise children when they're using playground equipment.
tgt_text: Kabe ange nabana bao ekero bakogosori nebinto biria biogokorerwa chigosori.

src_text: Keep walkways clear of obstacles to prevent trips and falls.
tgt_text: Rusia kegocha kende giosni ase abanto baogoetera gokonya abanto mbagochwa na kogwa.

src_text: Do not leave your vehicles open or valuables visible.
tgt_text: Tomocha gotasieka erori yao gose gotiga ebinto biengencho kororekana ime.

src_text: Make an emergency kit with a flashlight, batteries, first aid, and drinking water.
tgt_text: Kabe nebinto bia ntenera biranyare kogokonya ekero kiobokongu buna ekero esitima etaiyo obe etochi koreta oborabu ase eyomba, amo namasasi, na amariogo, namache okonywa.

src_text: Keep your doctor's and hospital's numbers nearby in case of emergencies.
tgt_text: Gacha enmba yanyagitari nomonyagitari oo ange nase ebogete omobuko oo bwemebasekano buna amarigo.

src_text: Keep emergency exits clearly marked and unobstructed in public buildings.
tgt_text: Erokeria buya aase okominchoreria elekero kiemebasekano ere na etbwati binto biranyare kogocha abanto kabagotama.

src_text: Always lock doors and windows when leaving home, even for short periods.
tgt_text: Kera chingaki sieka emerangu nechitirisa ekero ogosoka korwa inka, nonya nase egeka egeke.

src_text: Park in well-lit areas at night and check surroundings before exiting vehicle.
tgt_text: Ekero ogoteneni erori yao botuko yeteneni ase oborabu bore boisaine, na mongera aaria na gochia aaria buya nyuma otarasoka korwa erori ime.

src_text: Don't resist during armed robbery - your safety is more valuable than property.
tgt_text: Ekero ebibago biobibi bikogosagana tiga kwamererania nabarabwo- obogima bwa nobwengencho kobua enibo.

src_text: Promote integrity and transparency in all institutions. Together, we can prevent corruption before it starts.
tgt_text: Segeta ekeene nobomaiso marore ase chinsemo chionsi chiobokoreri. Ase oboamo, nabo togotanga obokorekanu tiboba.

src_text: Report irregular hiring and misuse of public office. Fair recruitment builds trust and accountability.
tgt_text: Karwe eripoti igoro yokorikwa kwa abanto omoroberio omoronge otabwatirie ase ogotumia bobe ofisi yobokoreri bwabanto. Okorika abanto ase omoroberio omuya nigo ogosegeta obwegenwa noboteneri obuya.

src_text: Be cautious about sharing personal information on phone calls.
tgt_text: Renda tobaise gosanga amangana ao abobisi gose ayengencho na monto onde bwensi goetera chinkwana ase esimi.

src_text: Keep shrubbery near entry points low to maintain visibility.
tgt_text: Simeka amaoga ase omorangwa gose egesona kiao.

src_text: We urge citizens to cooperate with security personnel as they perform their duties and use lawful channels to address their grievances.
tgt_text: Nigo togosaba abanainchi babweterane nabarendi boborendi chingaki bagokora emeremo yabo ase ogotumia chinchera chireo korwa okwemurunganania kwabo.

src_text: Don't leave purses or wallets unattended in shopping carts or public places.
tgt_text: Tiga gotiga ebibeti biechibesa bitarendiri na monto ase eduka, echiro gose aande onsi.

src_text: Don't leave doors and windows open at night, even if it's very hot.
tgt_text: Tobaise gotiga omorangu gose etirisa bitasiekirie botuko, nonya riberera rire rinene.

src_text: UNDP feature on community policing, Nyumba Kumi and Youth liaison programs in Kenya
tgt_text: Obomo bwechinse chikwegambera nemeroberio yamagenderero (UNDP) nkworokereria ere igoro yabarendi boborendi (Community Policing), Nyumba Kumi amo nemeroberio yogoikera abasae (Youth liaison programs) aiga Kenya

src_text: TOday GBV-capacity workshop with NPS and community figures across Kisumu subcounties
tgt_text: Rero ogomomia gokinia okomanya igoro yogokorera bobe abande ase yeki bare ase abasikari nabanto bande bebinyoro basikire ase amechie emeke yonsi inse ye'kaonti ya Kisumu

src_text: NPS published an official Text for community policing roles and expectations to help residents and officers work together more effectively
tgt_text: Ekeombe keria ekekene kiabasikari (NPS) ngiatomete amanga amen'ge gochia abarendi boborendi bwebinyoro goetera esimi kobamanyia emeremo yabo nekere gekageire korwa asebare gokonya abamenyi na abaofisa gokora emeromo amo keboikeranu.

src_text: NPS urged by IPOA and oversight bodies to strengthen community policing to improve public trust
tgt_text: Ekeombe ekenene kia abasikari NPS giasoroirwe nekeombe keria getenerete abasikari bonsi (IPOA) na bonsi baria bakorigereria emeremo yabasikari bae abarendi boborendi bwenyiro chunguru buna enchera eyemo yokoirania okwegena.

src_text: University of Nairobi research identifies communication as key to community trust and COP effectiveness in Ruai Township
tgt_text: Eyunifasiti ya Nairobi ekorigia chisemi chinyia yaorogetie nga ogokwanerana bun egento kiengencho koreta obwegenwa ase ebinyoro na okobwtera nebinyoro korwa oborendi (COP) ase oboikeranu aria etaoni enke ya Ruai.

src_text: Police credit community policing efforts for a marked decline in murders, defilement and other serious crimes in Mwala Machakos County
tgt_text: Abasikari baitabire oborendo bwebinyoro ase ogokeie obosareku bwogoita, gotibonga na amamocho ande amabe aaria ekaonti ya Mwala Machakos.

src_text: An IPOA warning stated that silence within the police force enables impunity and called for cultural reforms and safe reporting.
tgt_text: Ogokurerwa korwa ekeombe keria gietenerete korigereria buna abasikari bagokora emeremo yabo (IPOA)ngwatebete ng’a ogotakwana buna abasikari bagokora bobe nenchera eyemo yagerire abasikari bagendererete gokora amamocho na gotegwa egesusuro, nagosaba ng’a oboonchoreria goetera chinchera chiegenka kobe erio korwa ribaga abanto koripoti.

src_text: DCI urged citizens to submit crime complaints or tips directly to DCI offices or email to improve investigative response.
tgt_text: Omosikari omonene bwobotuki (DCI) osoroire abanainchi babe bagotoma okwemurangania kwabo gose bosemia konde gwonsi gochia asare ere omonyene gose komotomera eimeiri erio kwangoyia obotuki nokoiraneria.

src_text: Interior Ministry warned ahead of protests, urging peaceful demonstrations and placing security forces on alert.
tgt_text: Eminisitiri yoboredi bwa ime yakurerwe nyuma yokoroberekana gotaraba, egosorora nga okoroberekana kobe okwomorembe na kobeka ebitengo bionsi bioborendi maiso.

src_text: Government declared a nationwide high-alert and urged citizens to remain calm, report suspicious activity, and cooperate with security agencies.
tgt_text: Eserikari yatangasire koba maiso ense engima na gosaba abanainchi koba abatoreru, korwa eripoti igoro ya ebire nechitang'utang'u, na kobwaterana nabateneneri bobosrendi.

src_text: NPS dismissed a viral terror-warning poster as a hoax and urged the public to verify information before sharing.
tgt_text: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abasikari (NPS) yakanete amangana igoro yokogosereria goetera eintaneti ng'a ebibago ngoaka biarenge epomu na gosaba abainchi koenekia amangana aya ase aruwete nyuma batarasareria.

src_text: A curfew was imposed in Mandera County to address rising insecurity and facilitate ongoing security operations.
tgt_text: Ogochika gotanga abanto mbasoka korwa chinka chiabo chinsa gete nkwabegetwe aaria ekaonti ya Mandera buna enchera eyemo yogokeania obokebago na kobeka oborendi ase omoroberio bwokogenderera.

src_text: Airports nationwide were placed on high alert with intensified screenings following a classified security memo.
tgt_text: Ebitii biechindeke Kenya engima mbiabiaboretigwe koba maiso na komongera buya baria bonsi bagosoa ase ebitii ebio korengana nogokurerwa kwa ime kwarwetwe nabarendi boborendi.

src_text: Authorities notified the public of an Al-Shabaab attack in Garissa and urged vigilance as additional troops were deployed.
tgt_text: Aabarai banyirie abanainchi igoro yobkebago bwogokwa epomu na Al-Shabaab aaria garisa Garissa na gosaba koba maiso buna enchera eyemo gokonya ebikosi bia abasikari biria biatomirwe.

src_text: NPS discredited multiple fake posters circulating online and urged the public to avoid sharing unverified content.
tgt_text: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abasikari (NPS)nkiangete ebinto birikire bia gosiarerwa goetera entaneti buna ebioborimo na gosaba banainchi berende kobisiarera.

src_text: AP News reported police use of tear gas on activists protesting a custodial death, reigniting public demands for justice and transparency.
tgt_text: Amang'ana amayia yabasikari boborai (AP) namanyetie buna abasikari barasete ebinto biraia bigokrwa erioki ase gochia ase abaegereri baria bare koroberekana ogori yomoegereri gokwera eseri ya porisi, na gosegeta abanainchi godai ekeene na obomaiso marore ase ayio.

src_text: Media oversight body condemned arrests and assaults on journalists covering protests, calling for an independent inquiry into press violations.
tgt_text: Abariki amang'ana ba Media oversight body mbatebete koba bobe okobwatwa na ogoakwa kwabariki amang'ana bare korika na kobwata buna okorobererekana kware gokorwa, na koboria nga obokongori bwabeene bokorwe komnya ninki kiagerete abariki amanga bare gosaganerwa.

src_text: Workshops trained young journalists in ethical verification, safe documentation, and protective practices during protest reporting.
tgt_text: Abariki amangana mbasometigigwe buna bakomanya oboikeranu bwamangana, korenda obobisi bwa baria bonsi bausikanete, na buna bakwerenda chingaki bare ase emeremo yabo yokorika amangana ekero giokorobererekana.

src_text: County public forums in Nairobi reviewed the updated National Strategy to Prevent and Counter Violent Extremism focusing on gender, youth, and technology.
tgt_text: Omosngerekano obonsi aaria Nairobi norigereretie keboyia emeroberio yaye na korwa omoroberio omoyia igoro yogotanga na korwania obokebago bwogosaria ebirengererio kwarengete abanto bechingencho chionsi, na mono abasae na tekinorochi erio gokora obokebago obwo.

src_text: The National Counter Terrorism Centre calls for prompt reporting of suspicious activities.
tgt_text: Ekeombe keria ekenene giokorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) kiaboririe nga abanto bagenderere gokenyia ebikoru baroche biechitangutangu.

src_text: A UN workshop brought together multiple sectors to improve strategies for preventing violent extremism.
tgt_text: Obomo bwechinse (UN) mbwaretete amo abanto ao ao korwa eserikari goikerania emeroberio yogotanga obokebago bwogosaria abanto amongo goetera amorokererio amabe.

src_text: A terrorism threat report outlines activity by al Shabaab and IS and stresses public vigilance.
tgt_text: Erpoti yobokebago igoro yokoruta chipomu yaorogetie ebokoru bia al Shabaab amo nobomo bwaisabanto batigare maiso.

src_text: Public awareness campaign strengthening intelligence sharing and trust between communities and security agencies.
tgt_text: Emeroberio yokomanyia abanto nigo egokong'ia okoererania kwobotuki na komenta okwegenana gati yabanto nabarendi boborendi.

src_text: Kenya Police measures to combat terrorism and violent extremism focusing on the Anti Terrorism Police Unit.
tgt_text: Emeroberio ya abasikari ba Kenya arengete abasikari baria boborendi bwogotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu, namangana yosaria obongo goetera amorokererio amabe.

src_text: Kenya’s cybersecurity strategy to protect critical information infrastructure and enhance public online safety.
tgt_text: Omoroberio o'Kenya korenda chisimi nechikombiuta tichitumeka bobe erio korenda amang'ana tasoa amaboko amabe buna enchera eyemo yogoikerania oborendi bweintaneti.

src_text: EACC recovered KSh 28B over six years, redirecting resources to public projects.
tgt_text: Ekeombe keria gekorwania obokengeka (EACC) nkiairanetie chieiringi chibirioni 28 gati yemiaka 6, na enibo eyio ekabagwa ase amagenderero ense.

src_text: EACC raised awareness at the 2025 Eldoret Show on reporting corruption.
tgt_text: Ekeombe keria gekorwania obokengeka (EACC) ngiakorete okomanya omoerio bwomwaka 2025 aaria ase amoorokereria yoboremi Eldoret buna aranyare koria eriporti igoro yobokorekanu.

src_text: ODPP introduced tech tools and plea deals to cut case backlogs.
tgt_text: Ofisi yomosoeri ebina (ODPP) yaansete egekoreri kigedichitarierio kwangoi gokora ebina ebinge korwa abwo magega.

src_text: Police in Malindi cutting juvenile crime through new initiatives.
tgt_text: Abasikari aaria Malindi babogoirie ebitambokero biogotanga obosari gati yabana goetra emeroberio emyia.

src_text: Canada warns travelers of protests and potential disruptions.
tgt_text: Canada yarure ogokurerwa gochia ase baria bakogenda chisafari igoro yokoroberekna amo nkoba gwechiburaburu.

src_text: Participate in programs advocating for mental health, gender equality, and disability rights.
tgt_text: kabe oyomo ase baria bakorwanererera gokora obochayi na bagosegeta omorembe bwebirengererio erio komenya buya,rwanerera oboreng'ananu bwabanto bonsi noboronge bwabaremaru.

src_text: Encourage proper vehicle maintenance, child safety, and driver education programs
tgt_text: Segeta oborendi bwechirori obuya, oborendi bwabana, nemeroberio yogomia abagendia chirori.

src_text: Participate in public safety campaigns and trainings in schools, markets, and transport hubs
tgt_text: Kabe oyomo gosegeta oborendi bwense na nomoroberio bwokwegeria chisukuru igoro yoborendi ase chisukuru chichiro nase chirori chikorinerwa.

src_text: Educate peers on amendments requiring public officers to declare gifts and prevent conflicts of interest
tgt_text: Somia bigori biao igoro yamaonchorerio yamachiko aganetie abanto korwa ebirengererio biabo ase ogochika korengete abakori emeremo beserikari komanyia chinibo babwate na goteba ebire baetwe buna ebieegwa gotanga dkorora nga emeremo yabo teri nogwanchereria.

src_text: Report corrupt officials to reinforce zero tolerance in institutions.
tgt_text: Karue amang'ana igoro yabakoreri abakorekanu gosegeta gokora obokorekanu as chiofisi.

src_text: Encourage private sector collaboration under integrity frameworks for unified anticorruption action
tgt_text: Kae omoyo abanyabiasara kobwaterana inse yamachiko obokeene gokinana keboamo gokora obokengeka.

src_text: Report economic crimes and procurement fraud to demonstrate community commitment to justice.
tgt_text: Manyia abarai igor obosaria bwobogoko nobokengeka ase okogora chitenda chieserikari buna enchera yokworokia okobwaterana nebinyoro gokora ekeene.

src_text: Support education for street children; success stories inspire action.
tgt_text: Sira emeroberio yechisemi ase abana baria bameneyete ebisona ase emechie emenene; emegano yebitambokero biobobui ngosegta bire kobogoria etambokero.

src_text: Support residents fighting for access to water and basic services.
tgt_text: Sira emeroberio yabamenyi konyora amache nebinto biengencho bibabwenerete.

src_text: Explain legal rights when arrested to the public.
tgt_text: Manyia abanto oboronge bwao bwamachiko ekero kwabwatirwe nabanto.

src_text: Support mobile legal aid clinics serving rural communities.
tgt_text: Konya, karwe chibesa, na roberia buna orabwaterane nabagambi ebina kotini goikera baria bare risabu korwa obogambi bwa bosa kobakonya konyora ekeene kiabo.

src_text: Members of the public are encouraged to support this initiative by sharing information on suspicious activities and joining efforts to protect communities, especially the youth, from the dangers of drug and substance abuse, NPS said.
tgt_text: Abanto bonsi basegetirwe kobwatisia omoroberio oyo ase okobwaterana goetera okomanyia abasikikari igoro yebikoru bare nechitang'utang'u nabirobio na ase oboama korende ebinyoro biabo, mono kegima abasae, kporwa ase omochando bwamariogo nebinto bigotindia, NPS batebete.

src_text: Authorities are now appealing to members of the public to support ongoing efforts to combat crime by sharing information that could aid investigations.
tgt_text: Abarai bono appealing to members of the public to support ongoing efforts to combat crime by sharing information that could aid investigations.

src_text: The event, held at Gilgil Stadium, was streamed live on KDF platforms to promote transparency and educate the public on the recruitment process.
tgt_text: Aya iga nigo abete aaria egetii kiemesiecho kia Gilgil, ayio aorogetigwe etibi korwa ekeombe kioboami bwoborendi bwense (KDF) gosegeta obomaiso marore na gosomia abanto buna okorika abaami gokoba.

src_text: Members of the public and property owners are reminded to prioritize structural safety in residential buildings.
tgt_text: Abanto bonsi nabanyete enibo bwainyoriigwe korenda buna amaagacho echinyomba gose chitaracha chigwata goikerania oborendi obuya ase chinyomba chiokomenya.

src_text: We caution all to beware of fraudsters posing as Commission staff to solicit money in exchange for our services.
tgt_text: Nigo togokurera abanto koba maiso igoro yabasaria bagwekora koba abakomisona baita erio koibera abanto chibesa chiabo.

src_text: Ethekon urged Kenyans to help rebuild trust in the new IEBC, assuring that the commission has strengthened accountability systems, including robust voter identification and result transmission technology.
tgt_text: Ethekon nasabete aba'Kenyansgokonya koagacha obwegenwa ase oborai oboyia bwekeombe keria getenerete goakia chikura (IEBC), koenekeria abakenya ng'a obotenereri bwabo bwkongirie obomaiso marore, amo nokomongera buna chikura korwa chisenta chigotomwa goetera tekinorochi.

src_text: Constructively participate in the forums and platforms created by the County Government for Public Participation; Seek the guidance of the county government where the person is unable to read or to access information on the Public Participation Issue.
tgt_text: Gitegerera na koboria amaswari ase emekutano yeserikari yechikaonti konyora ebirengererio bia abanto; Rigia ogokonywa korwa aserikari yekaonti ase baria batamanyeti gosoma na korika goikera amang'ana igoro yogosanga nagokwanerana.

src_text: 750 million into project Thiba Dam site assets handed over to Kirinyaga County Government as Waiguru promises to convert it into hospital Waiguru backs President Ruto's Broad Based Government, urges residents to resist divisive leaders Sagana Industrial City to support farmers, create 150,000 jobs, Waiguru says as Ruto pledges to inject Ksh.
